title: HANDOVER.md documents worktree_gc.sh --apply; the script refuses --apply
claim: dev/programme/HANDOVER.md says `worktree_gc.sh --apply` collects detached clean worktrees; tools/audit/worktree_gc.sh exits 2 with 'REFUSE: unknown option --apply' (collecting is its default, --dry-run the preview).
mechanism: The trap entry names a flag the script never had or has lost; its parser accepts only --dry-run, --strict and --keep-dir.

evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; a count is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb worktree_apply: the temp tree's parser accepts --apply as a no-op

metric_definition: whether `bash tools/audit/worktree_gc.sh --apply --dry-run o/r` in a clean baseline tree prints the unknown-option refusal
phenomenon_property: Every command line the handover documents is accepted by the script it names.
proposed_fix_scope: Edit the trap entry in dev/programme/HANDOVER.md to `worktree_gc.sh <owner/repo>` (with --dry-run to preview).
seam_rule: dev/audit/rounds/round11/D6/s5/assemble.py --repo <clone> (ledger.tsv rows whose verdict is false or stale; atoms.py --list-stale for path, symbol and flag atoms)
